question: How can śiva be reached through lower faculties without denying his supremacy?
premises: In reality, śiva alone is the self-luminous reality.
Śiva can conceal his own nature.
After concealing his nature, śiva can appear again in that lower mode.
inference: The lower faculties can reach śiva because it is śiva himself who, while self-luminous, conceals and manifests his own nature through them.
plain_english: The answer is this: in reality it is śiva alone, self-luminous by nature. Having concealed his own nature, he appears again in that very form.
